meta.grade_scale: xfv_grade_quantile is the DISPLAYED grade site-wide: the model's outcome-grounded ranking mapped onto the familiar 20-80 consensus scale, and the grade surplus_mm is priced on (owner: eFV + eFV surplus consistent everywhere, matching /projections/). xfv_grade / xfv_grade_realized is the honest pure-model grade -- realized_implied_fv(E[6yr WAR]), deflated -- kept as a secondary reference; the outcome distribution p_bucket / p_bust stays on it (validated star/bust odds). Live board players carry kind=active + a surplus dist; they require a pro track record (eFV abstains on players with no MiLB production).
